p: for ever: He declares that his afflictions lasted a long time, and that his faith did not waver.
counsel in my soul: Changing my purposes as the sick man does his place.
prevailed against him: Which might turn to God's dishonour: if he did not defend his.
mercy: The mercy of God is the cause of our salvation.
dealt bountifully with me: Both by the benefits past and by others to come.
